name: read
description: Read a bounded page with line numbers. Supports UTF-8 (BOM stripped), UTF-16 and GBK/GB18030, PDF text layers, and rendered ipynb cells/text outputs. UTF-8 files can be any size; decoded documents default to a 20 MB input limit (MINICODE_TEXT_DECODE_MAX_BYTES). Use next_offset and opaque next_cursor to continue, including through a long line. Also reads PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP as actual image content when the model supports images. Edits and writes preserve an existing text file's encoding and BOM or fail without changing it.

offset.description: 1-based line number of the first line to return
offset.title: Offset

limit.description: maximum number of lines to return
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: opaque next_cursor from a previous page
cursor.title: Cursor

name: bash
description: Run a shell command inside the workspace (PowerShell on Windows, bash elsewhere) and return its combined output and exit code. Foreground commands are killed after timeout_s (default 300s, capped at 3600s) so a stuck shell cannot block the turn; set timeout_s to raise the bound. Set background=true to start the command as a background job instead: it returns a job_id immediately, runs without the default bound (timeout_s still applies when given) and its result is delivered by the system once the job completes. Output keeps a head/tail preview within 2,000 lines or 50 KiB, with complete output in an artifact subject to the configured output retention policy. Requires approval.

name: edit
description: Edit one file atomically. Use old_text/new_text or edits[] (1–100 operations against the original snapshot). Exact matching is preferred, then unique normalized matches for trailing whitespace, typographic quotes, Unicode compatibility variants and common indentation. Ambiguity or overlapping edits fail without writes. Failed matches return candidate lines without applying them. Set match_mode=exact to disable normalization. Existing encoding/BOM are preserved.

old_text.description: exact text to replace; must match the file exactly
old_text.title: Old Text

replace_all.description: replace every occurrence instead of failing on ambiguous matches
replace_all.title: Replace All

old_text.description: exact text to replace; must match the file exactly
old_text.title: Old Text

replace_all.description: replace every occurrence instead of failing on ambiguous matches
replace_all.title: Replace All

name: write
description: Create a new file or overwrite an existing one with the given content, returning a unified diff against the previous state. Prefer edit for changing existing files.

content.description: full file content; overwrites existing files
content.title: Content

name: ls
description: List up to 500 entries in one directory (50 KiB UTF-8 maximum). Set recursive=true to descend; large recursive results use an indented tree to avoid repeating path prefixes. Use next_offset to continue.

name: grep
description: Search file contents with a non-backtracking Rust regular expression (no lookaround or backreferences), returning 'path:line: text' lines (100 by default, 50 KiB maximum). Directory searches respect .gitignore and .ignore; include_ignored=true disables ignore-file rules. Existing fixed directory exclusions remain. Explicit files are searchable even when ignored. Hidden files remain searchable. Set case_sensitive=false for case-insensitive search.

include_ignored.description: disable ignore-file rules for directory searches; fixed directory exclusions still apply

name: read_artifact
description: Read a session artifact. Character pagination defaults to limit=4000, offset=0. Optional start_line/end_line select inclusive 1-based lines; pattern searches lines using Rust regex; tail_lines selects the last 1–2000 lines before pattern filtering. Line views include line numbers and accept limit as a character budget, with next_start_line hints. Do not combine line views with a nonzero character offset or tail_lines with a line range. Other sessions remain inaccessible.

pattern.description: non-backtracking regular expression, applied to each selected line

name: skills_list
description: List available local skills by name and description. Skill bodies are not loaded.

name: skill_load
description: Activate a named skill and read its instructions. Activation does not grant tool permissions.

name: skill_unload
description: Deactivate a previously loaded skill for this session.

name: skill_resource
description: Read a file inside a registered skill directory; scripts still require normal bash approval.

name: delegate
description: Delegate a bounded task to an assistant with its configured tools and the parent permission policy. Available kinds: explore, review

name: task_create
description: Add a durable session task; dependencies must already exist.

name: task_list
description: List durable tasks, dependencies, owners and statuses in this session.

name: task_claim
description: Claim one ready task for the current agent; blocked dependencies cannot be claimed.

name: task_complete
description: Finish a task claimed by this agent; success unblocks dependents.

name: memory_list
description: Recall user-saved stable project facts with their sources and scopes. Optional path filters relevant facts.
